title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: Components let write data transformation reuse across studies swapping variable names render time. Instead copying modifying code new study, maintain single template. mighty component reusable code template single, well-defined data transformation step. Components commonly used generate ADaM (Analysis Dataset Model) programs, concept general: parameterized R code snippet reads data set, modifies , writes back can expressed component. Components combine two ideas: Mustache templating — placeholders like {{{ domain }}} filled render time, logic works across different data sets variables. Roxygen-like documentation — tags like @title, @param, @depends describe component , needs, produces. Think components reusable building blocks: one handles single derivation transformation, compose several build complete program. broader mighty ecosystem, mighty.metadata provides study-level configuration (via mighty_study() _study.yml) can drive components rendered parameters.

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: minimal component doubles column. Every tag visible glance:
code: #' @title Double a variable #' @description #' Creates a new column that is twice the value of an existing column. #' #' @param domain `character` Name of the domain (data frame) #' @param input `character` Name of the existing column to double #' @param output `character` Name of the new column to create #' @type column #' @origin Derived #' @method Doubles input #' @depends {{{domain}}} {{{input}}} #' @outputs {{{output}}} #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::mutate(     {{{output}}} = 2 * {{{input}}}   )

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: Components use Mustache — simple, logic-less templating language. Inside @code, {{{ }}} Mustache placeholders, R syntax. text-replaced concrete values code parsed R. Rendering done whisker R package. three patterns used components : {{ variable }} — replaced value supplied render time. {{{ variable }}} — unescaped replacement. Used value literal R code (e.g., {{{ value }}} insert 1, "text", expression). {{#list}}...{{/list}} — repeats body element vector parameter. Mustache template variables double braces {{}} HTML escaped default. Since mighty renders R code, recommend using triple braces {{{}}}. See Mustache manual full syntax reference.

title: Getting Started with mighty.component
text: input data set always called {{{ domain }}}. code must assign result back {{{ domain }}}. Use explicit package namespaces (dplyr::mutate(), mutate()). Joins must always specify explicit argument — enforced automatic validation (see Automatic code validation).

text: component rendered, generated code automatically validated. package currently checks implicit joins — dplyr::left_join(), dplyr::inner_join(), similar call without explicit argument triggers error. prevents common source bugs clinical programming join columns change studies. component fails validation: fix specify join key explicitly:
code: #' @title Bad join example #' @description Implicit join that will fail validation. #' #' @param domain `character` domain name #' @type row #' @origin Derived #' @method Implicit join on other_data #' @depends {{{domain}}} USUBJID #' @outputs NEWCOL #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::left_join(other_data) get_rendered_component(bad_file, list(domain = "ADAE")) #> → Found "file1aca57dce20b.mustache" in "local::/tmp/RtmpGjNA5H" #> Error in `abort_validation_errors()`: #> ! Component validation failed: #>  #> ! Implicit dplyr join(s) detected in rendered component: #> ✖ Join operations must explicitly specify the `by` argument #> ℹ Line 2: dplyr::left_join #' @title Good join example #' @description Explicit join that passes validation. #' #' @param domain `character` domain name #' @type row #' @origin Derived #' @method Explicit join on other_data by USUBJID #' @depends {{{domain}}} USUBJID #' @outputs NEWCOL #' @code {{{domain}}} <- {{{domain}}} |>   dplyr::left_join(other_data, by = dplyr::join_by(USUBJID)) get_rendered_component(good_file, list(domain = "ADAE"))$code #> → Found "file1aca5bbff301.mustache" in "local::/tmp/RtmpGjNA5H" #> [1] "ADAE <- ADAE |>"                                              #> [2] "  dplyr::left_join(other_data, by = dplyr::join_by(USUBJID))"

title: Component repos — mighty_repo
text: mighty_repo(): Create component repo spec. mighty_repo_class: Abstract parent class component repos. properties created directly. Specs form type::path. Supported types: local: local directory, e.g. local::inst/examples. spec without prefix treated local. github: GitHub repository, e.g. github::owner/repo/subdir@ref. See mighty_repo_github(). url: Raw files base URL, e.g. url::https://example.com/components. See mighty_repo_url(). repo types share one layout. component name file <name>.R <name>.mustache, either directly repo directory named component (<name>/<name>.R). name extension matches file.

title: mighty.component (development version)
text: Component repos S7 classes: mighty_repo(), mighty_repo_local(), mighty_repo_github() mighty_repos(). GitHub repos use github:: prefix (#108). find_component() exported, list_components() works repo types (#103). Components can retrieved URLs mighty_repo_url() (url:: prefix), time limit per request (timeout option) (#104). GitHub repos cached per commit, transient API errors retried (max_tries option) (#93, #95). @origin now required tag every component header, optional. New required @method tag component headers, exposed component$method. Intended let mighty.metadata populate column’s define.xml method description directly component. mighty_component$render() now recognizes .mighty_subset(domain, subset) marker call passed value domain parameter. lets callers (e.g. mighty.metadata’s pooling feature) restrict @type row component’s derivation subset rows without corrupting @depends/@outputs/@type parsing silently dropping added rows. Parameter values aren’t exact .mighty_subset(...) call unaffected. marker parameter domain raises error.
